0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Warriors visit the Lakers, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Golden State a 35% chance to win. Last season the Warriors lost the series to Los Angeles 1-3, including a 119-103 loss in San Francisco on April 9. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while the Lakers' Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr and Collin Sexton are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
